description: This file defines a struct called CorrelationId within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. The CorrelationId struct is a read-only value type designed to generate and compare correlation IDs, primarily for tracing or identification purposes within Orleans messaging infrastructure. It includes methods for generating the next ID, comparison, equality checks, and formatting as a string.

classes.name: CorrelationId
classes.description: An immutable struct representing a correlation identifier, with methods for creating, comparing, and formatting IDs.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Generates the next CorrelationId by incrementing the static lastUsed counter atomically.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the correlation ID.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this CorrelationId and another object or CorrelationId.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this CorrelationId with another for ordering.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ID in hexadecimal format.

methods.name: IFormattable.ToString
methods.description: Formats the ID according to the specified format and provider.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the ID into the provided Span<char> with the specified format and provider.

methods.name: ToInt64
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the underlying long ID value.
